defects.description: spine=+12 (forward lean) but description says "Turn the body sideways and press just one shoulder flat against the wall, feet staggered a full step away from the surface". With spine=+12, shoulders at z=+0.116 (FORWARD of hips at z=0) — shoulders are away from a back-wall, not against it. For shoulder-against-wall-behind, spine should be NEGATIVE (backward arch) to bring shoulders back toward wall.

Feet not staggered a full step. Description: "feet staggered a full step away from the surface". Currently leftFoot z=+0.110, rightFoot z=+0.205 — only 0.095m stagger (≈10cm). A full step is ~30cm. leftHip=-6 produces minimal backward swing.

regression_risk: low — 2 fields, single-pose. Spine flip brings shoulders back toward wall. leftHip increase staggers feet more (left foot back, right foot forward). rightHip:0 preserved (standing leg). hipAbductL/R:+10 preserved (slight leg cross). No arm changes.
rationale: CORRECTED CONVENTION: spine + = forward lean, - = backward arch. Description: "Turn the body sideways and press just one shoulder flat against the wall" — wall is behind (z negative direction), shoulder blades should lean back against it. Currently spine:+12 puts shoulders at z=+0.116 (forward of hips) — opposite of wall-press intent. Flipping to spine:-12 brings shoulders to z≈-0.12 (behind hips, against wall). Matches the related back-wall-prop pose pattern (spine:-12, shoulders at z=-0.135 behind hips). leftHip:-6→-30 increases backward swing of left leg, staggering feet by ~25-30cm (full step). rightHip:0 preserved (right foot forward, planted as stance leg). Note: description also says "Turn the body sideways" — would require globalTwist for true sideways turn, but adding globalTwist without rendering verification is risky. The spine+stagger fix addresses the more visible defects (shoulder contact + foot stagger). globalTwist left for follow-up if needed.
